entities.name: Štefan Haššík
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Štefan Haššík was a Slovak politician who was the Minister of Defense of the Slovak State from 5 September 1944, replacing Ferdinand Čatloš who supported the Slovak National Uprising. He was sentenced to death in absentia, but fled after the war.
